mapper.sql: SELECT seal_id, seal_name, seal_code, seal_type, keeper_name, keeper_dept, keeper_phone, keep_place, enable_date, status, flow_instance_id, attachment, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark, (SELECT f.title FROM flow_data_17 f WHERE f.process_instance_id = flow_instance_id LIMIT 1) AS flow_title, (SELECT f.return_time FROM flow_data_17 f WHERE f.process_instance_id = flow_instance_id LIMIT 1) AS use_return_time, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ACT_RU_EXECUTION r WHERE r.PROC_INST_ID_ = flow_instance_id COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci) THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS flow_running FROM biz_oa_seal
